title: Kat client core JSONL v1 + host-only egress + safe logs + manual probe settings + Kat JSON/YAML source
description: UTF-8 JSONL; max 2097152 bytes per frame excluding newline; <=16 inflight; responses out of order with exact id. x-methods maps method results. Kernel document and imported outbounds retain actual Kat fields, not a second config schema. network.egress.* MUST NOT pass Rust public core_request. Linux does not expose network.egress.v2 capability. logs.get is public and additive; protocol remains 1. Cursor/dropped semantics are in x-methods.logs.get. Desktop source format is json/yaml/yml; wire protocol remains JSONL and protocol 1. Optional format defaults to the active extension. See contracts/YAML.md. Physical egress private payload schema 2 requires registered system_dns endpoints with owner LUID, family ifIndex, effective scope, and snapshot fingerprint. Old bare bootstrap_dns payloads are rejected; core JSONL protocol remains 1. Windows also requires network.dns-revision.v1. identity binds physical route/adapter identity independently of mutable DNS fingerprint; dns_revision changes without business generation changes. Windows TUN also requires network.flow-session.v1. Attribution typed events carry only finite reason/cause, rule and optional immediate Win32 code; raw kernel log messages remain a separate private channel.

url.description: Explicit HTTPS public subscription fetch; no redirect/userinfo/fragment. Never inferred from text.

include_group.description: One existing source group; omitted/empty retains legacy all-node preview. Empty filter with a source includes all source leaves.

group_name.description: Optional existing consumer group; requires include_group. Validates the proposed source edge (including mixed cycles). Omit for an unsaved new group.

add_rule.description: Explicit connection-generated active subscription local overlay rule; edit_only=true required.

rule_position.description: Global first / before MATCH, only with add_rule.

probe_at.description: Actual most recent manual probe completion from this client process; unknown null/omitted, never display clock time. No persisted probe history.

groups.description: Actual cumulative per-policy-group bytes from current Kat registry, not today or daily history; empty when unavailable. Nested groups may count the same flow at each group hop.

group.description: Accepted icon group display label only, bounded and no URL or query

clientProbeSettings.description: Optional fields in kat-client.json client object (not IPC method params). Runtime defaults only; no source normalization. Other existing client fields remain accepted. Duration numeric bounds and round>=point are validated by Go, not only this JSON shape. Background group.probe stays independent.

probe_timeout.description: Go Duration string, 100ms..60s; per HTTP probe after obtaining permit.

probe_round_timeout.description: Independent per-dequeued-member round budget including dependency preparation, never a shared whole-group or whole-batch deadline. Caller/Stop/Apply cancellation still wins.

probe_concurrency.description: Per-client permits shared by all manual node/group requests, not a global server limit.

close_on_switch.description: After a committed manual selected/fixed change, close only captured existing flows whose strategy chain contains the changed group. Automatic switches never close flows.

tcp_ports.description: Kernel port list/ranges, empty defaults to 80,443,8080,8443; none disables TCP sniffing.

udp_ports.description: Kernel port list/ranges, empty defaults to 443; none disables UDP sniffing.

timeout.description: Kernel Go duration: 1ms–2s, zero uses 300ms default; omitted uses default.

process_path.description: Verified native image path; unavailable empty/omitted. Private connection view only.

domain_suffix.description: PSL eTLD+1 of dest_host, for explicit rule editor prefill.

process_path.description: Verified native image path; unavailable empty/omitted. Private connection view only.

domain_suffix.description: PSL eTLD+1 of dest_host, for explicit rule editor prefill.

ipv6.description: Desktop-only local address-family policy. c16 one-time upgrade writes false and records a private migration report; subsequent explicit choice persists. TUN IPv6 capture routes remain installed in both states. Does not change physical NIC settings.

nameserver-policy.description: Ordered mihomo import subset: exact domain / +.suffix. JSON/YAML export retains the original field representation. Native rules containing keywords remain the rules array without conversion or error. Exclusive with nonempty rules; unsupported imported selectors reject. Source spelling/order retained until explicitly edited.

hosts.description: Exact or *.suffix keys, literal IPv4/IPv6 addresses. Exact wins, then longest wildcard suffix; wildcard excludes apex. IPv6 answers are inactive while client.ipv6 is false.

clientDNSSettings.description: Old server/servers/cache_entries semantics remain valid. First domain-policy match wins; each matched chain is isolated and does not leak to system on failure. Native source is retained, not reserialized from runtime.

tolerance.description: url-test default 50ms; smart default 30ms; numeric mihomo milliseconds; explicit zero retained. Strictly greater absolute difference plus all other stable gates.

automaticGroupSettings.description: Native Kat group extension. All auto groups always stable; all smart groups v2, no legacy mode. Performance fields only url-test/smart. Fallback/load-balance share fixed 2-success/5s interval/10s hold recovery, not latency selection.

address.description: Canonical unzoned literal IP; effective IPv6 zone is scope_id, not a user string.

selection_only.description: Optional true when only selected/fixed preferences changed on the existing running generation; all other edits retain full apply.

probe.node.description: One node or current route of a group, independent configured 5s target/10s own-round defaults, HEAD (405/501 GET in same deadline). Default permits50, explicit settings preserved. Errors appear inline via status.nodes and groups; no completion toast.

probe.group.description: Admit core-owned background member round; each member has own budgets, HEAD then GET only on 405/501; selected route for nested groups. Group URL takes precedence over client URL, explicit url takes precedence over both. Poll status.probe_round; no whole-batch deadline; actual results in status.groups.

url.description: Explicit HTTPS public subscription fetch; no redirect/userinfo/fragment. Never inferred from text.

dependency_groups.description: Only complete necessary Kat dependency group closure, not original whole proxy-groups/rules.

import.parse.description: Exactly one text (always pure parse) or explicit HTTPS url (bounded30s/no redirect/public checked literal dial/TLS/no env proxy). Import is draft-only. SS obfs-http and necessary via/url-test closure preserved; no unrelated rules imported. Native transport budget45s; wire protocol1 unchanged.

logs.get.description: after is an exclusive sequence cursor (default 0); entries are ascending. next_seq is the last returned sequence, or after if empty. dropped is cumulative ring evictions during this sidecar process (not filtering or since-cursor count). Ring max 2000; no disk history, no reset on core stop/start/reload. New process empty. Client logs.v1 capability. All entries come from allowlisted actual kernel calls at the configured kernel.log.level (default info). No raw fields/messages. Unsupported/filtered events create no entries.

connections.list.description: Logical TCP/UDP flows since this start. Closed ring 500 newest first, cleared on Stop; source prefix-truncated as ConnInfo.

logs.connections.description: Memory-only 2000 entries, exclusive after, ascending entries, next_seq last returned or after; dropped cumulative evictions; kept across Stop/Start. Never included in diagnostics.

dns.query.description: Running kernel resolver, ordered domain-policy rules, exact/wildcard Hosts and cache provenance. client.ipv6=false suppresses all upstream AAAA queries; type AAAA returns an empty list with server IPv6 已关闭 without network I/O. Enabled preserves the dual-family chain and view-only type filtering.

resources.list.description: No URLs, paths or free-form errors. Stopped configured resources pending. Nullable unknown metadata.

resources.refresh.description: Only rule_set/geoip/asn use configured safe HTTPS downloader. Stopped core returns core_not_running. Subscription-owned local resources with no remote URL return unsupported; update the complete subscription instead.

subscription.migrate.description: Preview one existing legacy provider as a complete subscription; no mutation until native backup + document.apply. Per-provider source identity and rollback are retained. Never accepts a URL/path supplied as a new provider.

probe.all.description: Immediate admission of a core-owned batch, with independent ordinary per-node HEAD budgets after dequeue, no shared batch deadline. Poll status.probe_round for actual completions and status.nodes for results. Stop/Apply/Close cancel; overlapping manual probes return probe_busy.

connections.close.description: Cancel only selected active TCP/UDP/TUN logical flows; duplicate/missing/already-closed ignored; return actual newly closed count. No kernel reload.

icon.get.description: Display-only bounded local image lookup. http/https via current kernel SOCKS routing when running; stopped direct retains checked-public SSRF policy. Redirects refused. Content image-only <=512KiB, inline SVG<=64KiB. URL-hash private cache7days stale-while-refresh; failure retains previous or returns empty, no raw errors.

include_group.description: One existing source group; omitted/empty retains legacy all-node preview. Empty filter with a source includes all source leaves.

group_name.description: Optional existing consumer group; requires include_group. Validates the proposed source edge (including mixed cycles). Omit for an unsaved new group.

group.filter_preview.description: Read-only exact kernel MemberFilter RE2 preview. With include_group, recursively flatten all effective source leaves in source order (not Current), deduplicate and filter; empty filter includes all. Optional group_name validates the proposed edge. Running uses current expanded generation; stopped uses accepted document plus local provider files/caches, never fetches. Without include_group legacy all-node/empty-filter-disabled behavior is unchanged. names are source matches before consumer manual-member dedup/1024 cap. Invalid regex/source returns names:[] and a safe error; no persistence or JS regex substitute.

logs.kernel.description: Private memory raw kernel log ring (2000), collected at configured log level. Original message is sanitized (URL query/userinfo/secrets), max 1024 bytes. after exclusive; next_seq last scanned including filtered entries; dropped cumulative; retained across stop/start. Not included in diagnostics. UI filter does not alter collection.

dns.cache.clear.description: Clear all live resolver generations IP and wire-answer caches, including domain-policy chains; returns removed entry count. Does not clear Windows or browser caches. Stopped core: core_not_running.

diagnostics.network.description: run=false (default) reads the last cached result without network. Explicit run=true only; one host batch, <=4 workers, each item all endpoints <=8s. HTTPS same-host redirects only; no cookies/login. Local SOCKS and actual final chain node. Exit groups are first five distinct routing targets + final group in rule order; cannot override groups from public params. urls only with connectivity, max16 HTTPS no userinfo/fragment. Results privately persisted (<=1 MiB/kind) until next successful batch, including application restart. No probe history writes.

add_rule.description: Explicit connection-generated active subscription local overlay rule; edit_only=true required.

rule_position.description: Global first / before MATCH, only with add_rule.

subscription.select.description: Existing local subscription edit/select preview, then same document.apply acceptance. add_rule explicitly owns a generated connection rule in the active local overlay; ordinary new-rule behavior remains manual.

rules.test.description: Target-only first-match lookup against accepted rules and loaded resources. Missing connection metadata stops at the earliest undecidable rule and is reported in missing. DNS only when destination IP is required; never connects to target, probes, selects an outbound, attributes a process or increments traffic/rule hits. Top-level effective separates actual mode routing from the rule-mode projection in result.

x-client-sniff.description: Optional client.sniff. Omitted is disabled; exact source bytes retained. Applies to generated kat-client inbound, including system proxy and TUN.

diagnostic_urls.description: Desktop only; explicit connectivity URL additions. No login, userinfo or fragment; Go parses again before requesting.

tray_sync.description: Projection of confirmed accepted main-window state only; cannot write config or network. Snapshot menu events are dispatched as tray-action to the existing DocumentSession document.apply / network paths. Busy/draft/install/uncertain states disable writes. Only local WebView has host-controls permission.

tray-action.description: Native event; same selected/fixed document.apply as main window, compatible with K1 close_on_switch. Show window for any failure; no success toast.

x-flow-session.description: Current-core-only, complete bidirectional authentication; held installation proof and lease/epoch revocation; no public method or mixed-component fallback.
